title: Patch: a deck holding a card the newest patch changed says so, and what changed

**Issue #2097 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #2097: Patch: a deck holding a card the newest patch changed says so, and what changed Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. ### What it does After a balance patch, players can't tell which of their decks it touched. A deck holding a card that the newest shipped patch changed should say so: a badge on its tile in the decks list and in the open deck's editor, such as "2 cards changed in v0.4.13". The badge opens the changed cards, each with what changed, from the card patch history the client already reads (`apps/web/src/patches/`: `history.ts`, `diff.ts`, `CardHistory.tsx`). A change to a card's `flavor` alone is not a change here (R1437000), and a deck with no changed card shows nothing. Once the deck is saved after the patch, the badge goes away for that deck, since its owner has seen it. ### Acceptance - A deck holding a card the newest patch changed shows the badge with the right count; one holding none shows nothing. - The badge lists exactly the changed cards in the deck, each with its change. - A flavor-only change doesn't count. - The badge clears for a deck once it has been saved after the patch. - Vitest covers all of the above. ### Blocked by, part of _No response_ --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_ ## Plan _Written by `claude-7` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40561361400)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal In the deck workshop (`/decks`), a deck's row in the list and its open editor show a badge when two things hold: its latest save came before the newest shipped patch, and it holds cards that patch changed. The badge reads "2 cards changed in v0.4.13" (or "1 card changed in …"). Pressing the badge lists exactly those cards, each with what changed, through the patch history's `diff.ts` and `ChangeList.tsx`. A flavor-only change does not count (R1437000), and a deck with no changed card shows nothing. Once the deck is saved under the newest patch, so that it carries that catalog version, the badge goes. The plan adds ruling R2097000, and Vitest covers every acceptance item. ## Files to touch | Path | new/change | What | |---|---|---| | `spec/rulings/R2097000.md` | new | The ruling | | `spec/11-rulings.md` | change | One paragraph at the end | | `spec/10-engine-guide.md` | change | One paragraph in §10.10 | | `spec/INDEX.md` | change | Regenerated by `cargo jackioh spec index` only | | `apps/web/src/patches/diff.ts` | change | `"flavor"` added to `KNOWN_KEYS` | | `apps/web/src/patches/deckChanges.ts` | new | `ChangedCard`, `NewestChanges`, `newestChanges`, `deckChanges`, `loadNewestChanges` | | `apps/web/src/patches/deckChanges.test.ts` | new | Pure tests | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/sync.ts` | change | `DeckItem.catalogVersion?`, set by `deckFrom`, `createDeck`, `updateDeck`, `importTrio` | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/sync.test.ts` | change | One new `describe` | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/testids.ts` | change | `DECK_PATCH_BADGE`, `DECK_PATCH_CARDS`, `deckPatchCardId` | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckPatchBadge.tsx` | new | `useNewestChanges` and the default `DeckPatchBadge` | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckPatchBadge.test.tsx` | new | Workshop tests | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckWorkshop.tsx` | change | Load the changes once; badge in `DeckRow`'s `
  • `; pass `patch` to the editor | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/DeckEditor.tsx` | change | `patch` prop; badge under the head | | `apps/web/src/game/deckbuilder/workshop.css` | change | `.ws-patch*` rules; touch size | | `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change | Three entries | | `apps/web/README.md` | change | One clause in the `game/deckbuilder/` row | Do not touch: - `crates/`: no Rust, catalog or patch fragment (`classify` rates this `app`), and the server already stamps every deck with `catalogVersion`. - `e2e/`, `apps/web/src/wire/` and `net/api.ts`. - `sync.ts`'s `deckInput`: `routes/decks.test.tsx` checks the PUT body exactly. - `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` and `.claude/`. Governing rules: §9.4, §10.10, R253 (each save carries `catalogVersion`; a stale one is refused), R256, R388, R507, R674, R1437000, CLAUDE.md rules 3 and 7. ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/patches/diff.ts`**: add `"flavor"` to `KNOWN_KEYS` after `"usesPlague"`, with the comment `// R1437000: display only and in no snapshot, so a change to it alone is no card change.` After this, `diffCard` never reports `data:flavor`. 2. **New `apps/web/src/patches/deckChanges.ts`** (pure). It imports `patchCards` and `versionBefore` from `./history.ts`, `type CardDelta` from `./diff.ts`, and `type Patch, type PatchSource, type Snapshot` from `./source.ts`. It exports: - `export type ChangedCard = Extract;` - `export type NewestChanges = { readonly version: string; readonly cards: ReadonlyMap };` - `newestChanges(patch: Patch, after: Snapshot, before: Snapshot | null): NewestChanges`. Body: `const { changed, dataOnly } = patchCards(patch, after, before);`, then return `{ version: patch.version, cards: new Map([...changed, ...dataOnly].map((delta) => [delta.id, delta])) }`. Added and removed cards are left out, and `patchCards` already skips Glitch. - `deckChanges(deck: { readonly cards: readonly string[]; readonly catalogVersion?: string }, changes: NewestChanges): ChangedCard[]`.
